parsed.notes:
Profil supplies required qualifications; Zusätzlich hilfreich introduces optional qualifications.
Cloud is required because the later Cloud-Architekturen qualification overrides the earlier ideally-qualified mention.
Mehrstufigen Workflows is provisionally mapped to LLM orchestration in its agent-development context; review flagged.
Systematic checking of AI-generated results is provisionally treated as AI output evaluation; review flagged.
Retrieval is left unmapped on a literal reading: neither vector retrieval nor retrieval-augmented generation is specified.
SaaS is optional; specification-driven development, Playwright and A2A are required; Accounting/ERP software, XRechnung and ZUGFeRD are optional and lack taxonomy entries.
HOAI and Bürocontrolling are excluded as domain knowledge. XRechnung and ZUGFeRD are treated as technical electronic-invoice standards.
GitHub maps to git through the supplied alias; GitHub Actions is not named.
Responsibilities alone do not establish additional requirements.
